Bake compact diagnosis previews into inst/previews

Source: R/maintain.R
bake_previews.Rd

Each design is baked independently. Failures are collected and returned; they do not abort the rest of the bake.

Usage

bake_previews(designs = NULL, sims = 100, seed = 343)

Arguments

designs

Ids/aliases, or NULL for shiny-included designs.

sims

Number of simulations (package default is 100).

seed

Seed set before each design is built and diagnosed, so a preview does not depend on which other designs were baked with it. The caller's random number stream is restored on exit. NULL leaves the stream alone.

Value

Invisibly, a list with paths (character) and failures (data frame with id and error).
